content: PWA install pitfalls: iOS Safari has NO automatic install prompt (no beforeinstallprompt support); install = Share > 'Add to Home Screen', hidden and rarely known; iOS 17.4 (Feb-Mar 2024) removed home-screen web apps in the EU citing DMA, Apple reversed March 2024 - PWAs still work in EU but open as Safari tabs with no push/badges; Android Chrome shows install banner; manifest needs correct icon sizes, maskable icons for Android, theme_color, start_url; iOS installed apps suffer cache staleness - content updates may not appear unless cache-busted or app re-added; display:standalone vs minimal-ui handling differs on iOS.
